name: Pyramids of Giza
prompt:
Create a cinematic desert scene featuring the three Pyramids of Giza at distinct realistic relative scales. Use square-based pyramids with clean triangular faces and subtle horizontal stone courses, sandy ground with gentle dune variation, low warm sun, long soft shadows and atmospheric depth. The great pyramid is the focal point. Elegant restrained composition from a low elevated camera.

Return only a complete HTML document without Markdown fences. Draw the entire artwork using the native HTML5 Canvas 2D API on a responsive full-window canvas, initially 1200x800. Preserve the composition on resize and redraw. Render the finished scene immediately, then set window.sceneReady=true. Use only native 2D drawing primitives. No WebGL, Three.js, 3D engine, external assets, images, fonts, imports or network calls. Depict the requested perspective using 2D shapes, paths and gradients. Create polished lighting, shadows and material variation with gradients and layered shapes. Frame the complete monument with its top and base visible and at least 10% margin. Do not obstruct it with foreground objects. No text overlays. Deterministic artwork, 1200x800 composition. Prioritize the visual result and working code. Use no more than 32000 output tokens including reasoning.
